The '''Kyuzo''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and green skin. They were fast and high jumpers.

==Society and culture==
[[File:Embo-Encyclopedia.png|thumb|left|180px|Kyuzo bounty hunter, Embo.]]
Kyuzo also spoke their [[Kyuzo language/Legends|native language]]. The species was known for having highly capable warriors, who had very high standards of honor.

The ''[[go-zeki]]'' were an organization of honor-fanatic Kyuzo [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]], identifiable by their skin, charred orange by their initiation rituals.<ref name="Wolf">{{StoryCite|story=Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke|book=SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story}}</ref>

==Kyuzo in the galaxy==
The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Embo/Legends|Embo]] was a member of this species. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he worked with fellow bounty hunters [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]], [[Seripas/Legends|Seripas]] and [[Rumi Paramita/Legends|Rumi Paramita]] to defend a village on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] from [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] raiders. He later worked with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in a plot to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], alongside [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Twazzi/Legends|Twazzi]], [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Rako Hardeen]].
Embo would take another job from the Confederacy to chase [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] off of Scipio.

Three Kyuzo ''go-zeki'' were active on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Wolf" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species name is taken from one of the character names of [[Wikipedia:The Seven Samurai|''The Seven Samurai'']] (七人の侍), a movie by [[Wikipedia:Akira Kurosawa|Akira Kurosawa]], to whom the [[Bounty Hunters (episode)|episode]] that the Kyuzo species and the bounty hunter Embo were introduced in was dedicated.<ref name="Bounty EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode217.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
